title: Align panel icons clip outside their buttons / render unclear
description:
REPRO: Open Properties > Align (Window > Align / Ctrl+K). The align / distribute / match-size / space buttons show crude ASCII text 'icons' (e.g. '|[', '[-', ']|', '|--|', '-+-', 'WH=', '|=|') that overflow past the button edges and look low-quality/unclear.

ROOT CAUSE:
- The buttons do NOT render real icons at all. They render multi-character ASCII text labels passed as the 'label' prop. See packages/authoring-ui/src/AlignPanel.tsx:540-582 (every <AlignButton ... label="|[" /> etc.). These labels were crude from the original implementation (commit 4b4e4cf, 'initial progress'), so the 'unclear/low quality' look is LONG-STANDING.
- The CLIPPING is caused by the re-theme. AlignButton (AlignPanel.tsx:164-185) fixes the button box at width:26px / height:22px (lines 168-169, original) and spreads buttonStyle() over it (line 167). buttonStyle() in packages/authoring-ui/src/theme/flash8Theme.ts:292-334 sets 'padding: "2px 8px"' (line 300) and 'display: inline-flex' + 'justifyContent: center' with NO overflow handling. 8px of horizontal padding on each side of a 26px button leaves only ~10px of usable width, so 3-4 char labels (|--|, WH=, -+-, |=|) overflow symmetrically past both button edges. The base button style has no overflow:hidden, so the text spills out.

REGRESSION VERDICT: MIXED.
- The crude/unclear ASCII glyphs are LONG-STANDING (original commit 4b4e4cf, 2026-06-09).
- The CLIPPING was introduced/worsened by the Wave B re-theme commit 4b234215 ('Flash 8 re-theme Wave B: inspector group -> light Halo', task 1248), which switched AlignButton from its old inline style to buttonStyle('over'|'up') (AlignPanel.tsx:167). buttonStyle adds padding:2px 8px that the previous inline style did not have, so the 26px-wide fixed buttons no longer fit their multi-char labels.

EXPECTED: Crisp align icons (proper Flash 8 align glyphs per docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md) that fit cleanly and fully within their buttons.
ACTUAL: Crude ASCII text 'icons' that overflow/clip past the button edges and read as low-quality.

FIX DIRECTION:
1. Replace the ASCII 'label' strings with proper inline SVG align/distribute/match-size/space icons (viewBox-scaled to fit the 26x22 button, e.g. 16x16 SVG centered), as called for by docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md. This fixes BOTH the clipping and the unclear look.
2. If keeping text short-term: reduce buttonStyle padding for icon-buttons (or override padding to '0' on the AlignButton style) and/or add overflow:hidden so labels do not spill; but the real fix is SVG icons.

INVESTIGATION-ONLY for this task: no e2e run performed (Playwright/Ruffle port 1420 in use). Code-path analysis only. HEAD at investigation: 05a10034f2c00bedea7f8390a7487816e329fd72.
